description: Use this tool whenever a user asks how much annual tax drag or multi-decade wealth they can save by coordinating ETF placement across Taxable Brokerage, Pre-Tax Traditional IRA/401(k), and Tax-Free Roth accounts (sheltering ordinary-income bonds/REITs in IRAs and placing high-growth equities in Roth), including SEC Rule 206(4)-1(d)(1) Gross vs. Net-of-Fee suitability.

incrementalFeeBps.description: Incremental advisory fee in basis points for household asset-location coordination (default 25 bps).

marginalOrdinaryRatePct.description: Federal marginal ordinary income tax bracket percentage.

portfolioValue.description: Total household investable portfolio across all accounts in USD.

pretaxIraSharePct.description: Percentage of household portfolio in Pre-Tax IRA / 401(k) accounts.

rothSharePct.description: Percentage of household portfolio in Tax-Free Roth accounts.

stateRatePct.description: State income tax rate percentage (0 for TX/FL/NV/WA).

targetBondWeightPct.description: Target household allocation to ordinary-income Fixed Income / REITs as %.

taxableSharePct.description: Percentage of household portfolio in Taxable Brokerage accounts.

name: calculate_asset_location_tax_alpha
title: Calculate Household Asset Location Gross & Net-of-Fee Tax-Alpha Across Taxable, IRA & Roth Sleeves
